public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI faces an inevitable liquidity crisis that its fundraising options only delay.

statement.excerpt: All of these ideas — like bringing Jensen back — are an attempt to delay an inevitable liquidity crisis which Altman likely hopes the government will step in to fix.

from_speaker: Altman likely hopes the government will step in
our_interpretation: A liquidity crisis means OpenAI cannot meet obligations when due without emergency financing, payment concessions or restructuring.
Ordinary fundraising and operating losses alone do not establish a liquidity crisis.
The nearby reference to needing money in the next few months does not give the predicted crisis a deadline.
The speculation about Altman's hopes is not treated as a separate prediction of government intervention.
criteria.support_condition: A documented inability to meet obligations, or emergency financing explicitly needed to avert that inability, establishes the predicted crisis despite earlier fundraising.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive termination of OpenAI's operations with all obligations discharged and no liquidity crisis could contradict inevitability. Continued operations or another successful financing round cannot alone disprove an unlimited forecast.
